paite: Huan Gaza ah Samson ahoh a, huai ah numei kizuak khat ava mu a, ava kithuahpih hi.
heading: Gaza Ah Samson

paite: "Samson hiai ah ahong hoh," chi in Gaza mite ahilh uhi. Huchi in ava umta ua, khopi kulh kongpi chin ah zankhua in atang uhi. Zankhua in adai sipsip ua, "Khua hong vak peuhmahleh, huchi in that na ni," akichi uhi.
Samson bel zankim tan in alum a, zankim in athou a, khopi kulh kongkhakte leh akhuam nih alen a, akalhnate toh aphawikhe vek a, aliangzang ah apua a, Hebron ma a mualvum ah apotou hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, anung in Sorek Phaizang a numei khat a-it a, amin Delailah ahi.
heading: Samson Leh Delailah

paite: Philistia' miliante akiang ah ahohtou ua, akiang ah, "Amah ka zohtheihna ding un, ahatna san theih tum in kankhia in. Huchi in ka vek un dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat ka hon pe chiat ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "Na hat mahmahna san hon hilh dih ve. Bangchi in ahia hihnat dia khau khihtheih na hih ding?" achi hi.
Samson in akiang ah, "Khauhual thak, keu nai lou sagih in hon hen le uchin, ka hat kei dia, midang bang lel mah ka hi ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in Philistiate' miliante'n khauhual thak sagih, keu nai lou apia ua, ama'n huaite in ahenta hi.

Dantan sunggil ah guktan mite akoih a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n hon sual dek uh e," achi hi. Mei in ziza khaulom akattat bang phet in ama'n khauhual ahihtanta hi. Huchi in ahatna san atheikhe zou kei hi.
Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "Ngai in, na hon khem a, zuau hon hilh na hi. Bangchi a hen theih ding na hia? Hon hilhta in," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Khauzen thak, zat nai louh in hon hen le uh, huchi in ka hat kei mai ding, midang bang lel mah ka hi ding," achi hi.
Delailah in khauzen thak ala a, ahen a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n ahon sual dek uh," achi hi. Dantan sunggil ah guktan mite a-om uhi. Akhut a henna patzang suktat bang mai in ahihtanta hi.

Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "N'on khem lai a, zuau na hon hilh lai hi. Bangchi a hen theih ding na hia? hon hilh dih ve," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka samphek sagih puan in gatkhum leteh ahi mai," achi hi.
Ama'n kilhna in akilhkip giugeu a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n hon sual dek uh e,” achi hi. Huchi in ihmu lai ahong halh a, puanbu kilhdenna leh puanbu nangawn toh kikhongsak in apaikhia hi.
Akiang ah, "Na lungtang hon pe hetloupi in, bangchidan a ka hon it, chi thei na hia oi? Tu'n thumvei hilhial na hon khemta hi, na hat mahmahna san na hon hilh nai kei lailai," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, niteng a ngen ngutngut a, adotdot ziak in, si ding khop hial in alunggimta hi.

Huchi in alungsim tengteng ahilh vekta hi. Akiang ah, "Ka lu ah mulmet tem himhim zat ahi ngei nai kei hi. Ka nu sul a ka om lai a pan Pathian a dia Nazarit mi dia na om ka hi. Tu in met taleng, ka hatna amang vek ding, huchi in ka hat kei dia, midang bang lel ka hi ding," achi hi.

Alungsim tengteng ahilh vekta chih Delailah in atheih phet in, "Tu kia hong hoh un, alungsim tengteng ahon hilh vekta," chi in Philistia' miliante thukhak in asamsak hi. Huchi in akiang ah Philistia' miliante ava hohtou ua, dangka atawi uhi.
Apheipi tung ah a-ihmusak hi. Mi asam a, asamphek sagihte ametkhesak vek hi. Huchi in amah ahihgim panta a, ahatna in anuseta hi.

"Samson, Philistiate'n ahong sual dek uh e,” achi hi. Ihmu lai ahong halh a, "Nidang mah bang in ka pawtkhe nawn ding a, ka kitungkhe nawn ding," achi hi. Himahleh TOUPA'N apaisan khinta chih himhim athei kei hi.
Philistiate'n aman ua, amitte akhelkhiaksak uhi. Gaza ah apaipihsuk ua, sikkol abunsak ua; suangkul ah buh gawizantu in apang hi.
Himahleh asam met ahih nung in hong pou in ahong khang nawn hi.
Philistia' miliante Dagon pathian kiang a kithoihna thupitak lan ding leh kihih nuamsa ding in akikhawm uhi. "I pathian un i melmapa uh Samson ahon peta," achi uhi.
heading: Samson Sihna

paite: Mipite'n amuh un apathian uh aphat ua, "I pathian un i melmapa, i gam hihsia a mi tampite thatpa i khut uah ahon peta," achi uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, alungtang un nuam asak laitak in, Samson pen muhnop ding in va sam dih ua, achi uhi. Huchi in suangkul a pan Samson ava samkhia uhi. Ama uah muhnop ding in a-omta a; khuam leh khuam kikal ah adingsak uhi.
Samson in amah kaitu naupang kiang ah, "Hiai inn dou pen khuam hon khoihsak dih ve, ka hon ngai deh," achi hi.
Huai inn, pasal leh numei in adim miuhmeuh uhi. Philistiate milian tengteng huai ah a-om vek ua, Samson muhnop dia en mite intung ah pasal leh numei sangthum a-om uhi.
Samson in TOUPA asam a, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, hehpih in hon theigige inla, hehpih in tutung in hon hihhat in, aw Pathian, ka mit langnih phu Philistiate tung ah tu kia hon lasak in," achi hi.
Samson in, huai inn dou pen sut nihte alen a, akhut taklam in khat, akhut veilam in khat mah apansan hi.

Samson in, "Philistiate toh sikhawm ning e," achi hi. Huchi in theihtawp in akunsuk a; miliante leh mipi asung a om tengtengte huai inn chim in adelhkhumta hi. Huchi in adam lai a athahte sang in asihkhumte atamzaw uhi.

Huchi in a-unaute leh apa inkote tengteng ahong paisuk ua, ala ua azawngtou ua, Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal a; apa Manoah kivuina mun ah avuita uhi. Huchi in ama'n kum sawmnih sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
